download_alpaca_dataset: download the Stanford Alpaca dataset from a URL and save it as a JSONL file
run_download_alpaca_cli: run the download_alpaca script with --output flag to save the Alpaca dataset to a JSONL file
download_alpaca_custom_url: download the Alpaca dataset from a custom URL using the --url argument
review_main_function: review the main function that downloads JSON data and converts it to JSONL format
summarize_download_alpaca: summarize the download_alpaca script that fetches ~52K instruction-following samples and saves them as JSONL
